_about: org-newest-members, Newest Members of Organisations (work in progress, ORGN-2, 2026-10-09). Each organisation's newest member, its date (when membership took effect), the member count and order, and Bangladesh's status — from the organisation's own pages (tier official) or, under the user's scoped exception, from two agreeing secondary sources read twice (tier secondary): notes/org-newest-members.md. A citation is a cached page's id (data-sources/org-newest-members/sources.json) with the offset, length and SHA-256 of the words in its text: no words are kept here. Country names come from Natural Earth's NAME_BN at build time, by iso3. Written by tools/.cache/org-newest/orgn2/seed.mjs.
